mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and compressing forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4.5% in the next month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to reduced growth expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross 4.5% threshold, or returns remain positive despite the rate increase (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above historical averages indicates robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth slows or inflationary pressures negate the supply-side boost (Rank IC < 0.03 over 60-day window).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession labor market normalization regime, rising UNRATE aligns with improving labor conditions, signaling stronger growth prospects and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative despite UNRATE rising in the regime, or the regime does not materialize as expected (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in GDPC1 above 23,000 billions of chained 2017 dollars indicates robust demand growth, driving corporate earnings and equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not cross the threshold, or returns remain negative (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises (tightening) while GDPC1 also rises (strong demand), conflicting signals create market uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (Rank IC > 0.05) or returns are positive despite the conflicting trends.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both INDPRO (supply) and GDPC1 (demand) indicates robust economic growth, amplifying corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Growth decelerates or inflationary pressures offset the positive signal (Rank IC < 0.03 over 60 days).

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening monetary regime where FEDFUNDS rise above 5.5%, higher discount rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 5.5% in the tightening regime
failure_condition: Returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS rising above 5.5% in the regime, or the regime does not persist (t-test p > 0.05).
